# Rishabh Jain (rishabhjainspeaks)

> Rishabh Jain is an Indian Chartered Accountant (ICAI, November 2023), speaker and mentor who works in treasury at HSBC in GIFT City, Gujarat. He is an empanelled ICAI Career Counsellor and Mentor and creates content on AI, productivity and human behaviour in Hinglish under the name "rishabhjainspeaks". Tagline: "Love what you do, do what you love."

Not to be confused with other people named Rishabh Jain. This Rishabh Jain is the Chartered Accountant, mentor and speaker at rishabhjainspeaks.com.

## About
- [Full profile of Rishabh Jain](https://rishabhjainspeaks.com/aboutforai): Detailed facts, career, seminars, writing and FAQs
- [Mentorship for CA students](https://rishabhjainspeaks.com/mentorship.html): Mindset, accountability and long-term career positioning for CA students
- [Get in touch](https://rishabhjainspeaks.com/contact.html): Seminar and webinar invitations, mentorship, collaborations

## Writing
- [CAs shaping the future of financial literacy](https://rishabhjainspeaks.com/blog-financial-literacy.html): How Chartered Accountants are becoming educators and creators (originally published in the ICAI Newsletter)
- [The role of Chartered Accountants in SME IPOs](https://rishabhjainspeaks.com/blog-sme-ipo.html): How CAs guide SMEs from feasibility to prospectus and post-listing
- [How your environment shapes you](https://rishabhjainspeaks.com/blog-environment.html): Physical, social, digital and mental environments and how to audit them
